insight: Raised a $60M Series B in 2023; in May 2026 it reported its Symphony model outscoring OpenAI on HealthBench Professional.
name: Corti
tagline: Clinical-grade AI platform and APIs for healthcare developers.
description: Corti is an AI platform for healthcare and life-science developers, offering clinical-grade APIs for medical speech-to-text, coding, and text generation plus an agentic framework with pre-built agents. Its proprietary Symphony model family powers more than a million clinical interactions a week, and the platform ships with FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, and ISO 13485 compliance plus an EU sovereign-cloud option. The Copenhagen company first made its name detecting cardiac arrests in live emergency calls.

modelSupport.notes: Serves its own clinical-grade models, led by the Symphony family, via API.

edge: Clinical-grade healthcare APIs with FedRAMP, HIPAA, and ISO 13485 compliance built in — regulatory depth general speech or LLM APIs don't carry.
cons: Usage-based costs add up at scale
